name: HRQ_QUESTIONNAIRES_B
description: Defines a set of questions that participants are to respond to.

columns.name: QUESTIONNAIRE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a questionnaire.  System generated id.  This attribute combined with the version number and business group id forms the primary key.

columns.name: QSTNR_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: The version number of the questionnaire. This attribute combined with the questionnaire id and business group id forms the primary key.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Identifies the status of the questionnaire.

columns.name: QUESTIONNAIRE_CODE
columns.description: Unique identifier for the questionnaire.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the questionnaire is used as a template.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Identifies the category id.

columns.name: SUBSCRIBER_ID
columns.description: Identifies the subscriber id.

columns.name: QSTNR_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the questionnaire template id.

columns.name: PRIVACY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the questionnaire is Private or Public.  Private questionnaires can only be updated by the owner.

columns.name: UPDATE_ALLOWED
columns.description: Not used

columns.name: OWNER
columns.description: Person Id of the owner of the questionnaire.

columns.name: SECTION_ORDER
columns.description: Order in which sections are displayed (fixed or random).

columns.name: SECTION_PRESENTATION
columns.description: Options for how sections are presented in the UI.

columns.name: PAGE_LAYOUT
columns.description: Options for how questions are presented in the UI.

columns.name: QSTNS_PER_PAGE
columns.description: Number of questions to show per page in the UI.

columns.name: IN_USE
columns.description: Indicates if there have been any responses submitted for this questionnaire.

columns.name: LATEST_VERSION
columns.description: Indicates if this is the latest version for this questionnaire id.

columns.name: VERSION_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of changes made when a new version is created.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SCORED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates questionnaire is a scored questionnaire.

columns.name: CALC_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Calculation rule for calculating overall questionnaire score.

columns.name: MAX_POSSIBLE_SCORE
columns.description: Maximum possible score for a questionnaire, used to determine passing score.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: LAYOUT_OPTION
columns.description: Layout option for the questionnaire

columns.name: SURVEY_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the survey type of the questionnaire.
